<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Move DOWN to align with blue block
result = action(['DOWN'])
print("DOWN result:", result.get('gameplay_changed'), result.get('level_completed'), result.get('done'))

lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
seg = current_frame.segmentation

# Check player position
print("\nPlayer area:")
for r in range(22, 30):
    row_str = lines[r]
    if 'M' in row_str[8:20]:
        m_cols = [c for c in range(8, 20) if row_str[c] == 'M']
        print(f"  Row {r}: M at cols {m_cols[:5]}")

# Check blue block
print("\nBlue block:")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] == 16:
        b = n['boundary']
        min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
        max_r = max(p[0] for p in b)
        min_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
        max_c = max(p[1] for p in b)
        print(f"  rows {min_r}-{max_r}, cols {min_c}-{max_c}")

# Check path
print("\nPath check:")
for r in range(24, 30):
    row_str = lines[r]
    path_cells = [c for c in range(16, 42) if row_str[c] in 'wg']
    if path_cells:
        print(f"  Row {r}: {len(path_cells)} cells, cols {path_cells[:3]}...{path_cells[-3:]}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
